performance.measurement_status: All 42 cases and exact checksums completed
performance.selection_rationale: The final source bounds M3 cursor allocation and state complexity while reducing repeated reverse resolution inside a scalar interval. It is not selected on a claim of universal elapsed-time improvement.
performance.negative_findings: Final reused atom forward/random and several unit/forward/shared/random medians are slower; fresh first-read and fresh-pass results are mixed. Candidate1/2 paths have stronger sequential gains but added allocation and material mixed-matrix regressions. Isolated candidate2 compound regressions do not reproduce; no compiler-causality conclusion is established.
performance.compound_leaf_payload_locality: Every compound fixture is made of real views over one actual 16,384-byte atom. It does not measure physically scattered native leaf allocations.
performance.heap_and_rss_interpretation: Heap samples and process max RSS include the JVM, oracle/fixture construction, compilation and GC; they are not retained owner-size measurements.
